text:
zoe: Heads-up — seeing a ~9% uptick in fncall validator rejects in global-us starting 02:07 UTC. Top tag = UNEXPECTED_ARRAY_ON_FIELD `attributes.tags`.
rahul: Yep, alert pages lit up. Strict-validator canary was pushed to 8% at 01:50 UTC.
mina: Sample (redacted):
```json
{
  "tool": "item_lookup",
  "result": {
    "id": "i_77",
    "attributes": {
      "tags": []
    }
  },
  "req": "r_xyz"
}
```
validator expects `attributes.tags` to be an object map (string->string), not an empty array.
ops: Can enable soft-validate for affected shards while infra patches. Which shards are noisy?
zoe: t-501 and t-502 have the highest reject pct. Ops, please soft-validate those for now.
ops: Doing soft-validate for t-501/t-502, annotating incident #7890.
rahul: Infra note: legacy adapter shim left one code-path that encodes empty tagset as `[]`. Quick fix is to coerce `[]|null` -> `{}` before validator call. Patch ready, ETA ~10m.
mina: Console request: can we add a "dry-run failover" / preflight that simulates routing 2% of the slice to the permissive variant and reports: expected p50 latency delta, token/cost delta, and number of requests that would have been coerced?
telemetry-bot: +1. We should also run a shape-coercion simulation against the last 10k payloads and report how many would flip shape (array->object), to estimate the size of the regression.
zoe: Another thing: we need a safety heuristic for automatic rollback of auto-fallback. Proposal: if semantic_regression_rate > 2% OR average user-latency increase > 30% for the failovered slice within 10m, then revert routing immediately and notify oncall.
rahul: I like the semantic_regression metric: compare key downstream signal (e.g., rerank loss or answer-sanity score) between baseline and permissive route. If permissive route materially degrades quality, failback.
billing-bot: Important: when we do failover, tag requests with `billing.label=validator_failover` and `routing.attribution=permissive_variant` so cost dashboards and quota accounting are accurate.
mina: Telemetry additions: emit span tags `validator.mode` (strict|permissive|soft), `validator.slice_pct`, and `routing.failover` (true|false). Add metrics: `fncall.validator.rejects_total{region,tenant,mode}` and `fncall.validator.failovers_total{region,tenant}`.
telemetry-bot: Also add a small sample retention / PII policy: store 0.5% of hard rejects as unmasked samples into secure bucket for 14 days; access gated to SRE+Platform with automatic audit log.
zoe: UX notes: the preflight dry-run UI should expose a conservative cost-estimate & p50 delta and require an explicit audit-reason when enabling auto-fallback. Add an interlock: auto-fallback disabled unless audit-logging ON for that rollout.
rahul: Implementation plan: 1) infra cut coercion patch (10m). 2) ops keep soft-validate on t-501/t-502 until patch verified. 3) console team to add preflight dry-run + interlock + audit reason. 4) telemetry to add tags/metrics and the sample retention. 5) billing to honor routing.attribution tag.
mina: I'll scope a tiny preflight API: `POST /rollouts/:id/preflight?dry_run_pct=2` which returns {coerced_count, est_latency_delta_ms, est_monthly_cost_delta}. We'll hide raw numbers behind RBAC.
ops: Once patch lands we'll run the preflight on a 5k-sample and if coerced_count < 0.5% and rejects drop <0.5% in 5m, we'll revert soft-validate.
telemetry-bot: Suggestion: surface a small sparkline on the rollout page: rejects_pct vs canary_pct vs dry_run_coercion_pct over last 60m.
mina: Also let's add a post-failover audit event that records actor, reason, preflight results, and the auto-rollback heuristic trigger if it fired.
zoe: Thanks. I'll monitor the incident. @rahul ping when patch released.
console-bot: deploybot: strict-validator canary set to 8% at 01:50 UTC by rahul
console-bot: opsbot: incident #7890 created "fncall validator rejects spike - global-us" assigned to eng-platform
